tests.question: Using GE_Vernova_Fleet_Ontology and its connected GE Vernova Fleet Performance (Import) semantic model, what is the exact total generation in MWh for January 1 through March 31, 2026? Use the model's Total Generation MWh measure, execute a query, and identify the source used.
tests.dax:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "Total Generation MWh", CALCULATE(
        [Total Generation MWh],
        KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(ALL('Date'[Date]), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE(2026, 3, 31)))
    )
)

publishedAcceptance.januaryGenerationDax:

SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Site'[Site Name],
    KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(ALL('Date'[Date]), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE(2026, 1, 31))),
    "Total Generation MWh", [Total Generation MWh]
)
ORDER BY 'Site'[Site Name]
